visual.world_identity.world: 东方天界的普通居民生活区，不映射现实国家；云海、云桥和层叠街区是日常地理，不是异常或法术展示
visual.world_identity.population: 普通二十多岁天界本地居民，外貌自然可信，禁止英雄化、明星化、网红化
visual.world_identity.architecture: 朴素石木居民区、公共轮值房、家常食肆、旧云市、茶摊、云桥；避免宏大神殿与仙侠宣传片构图
visual.world_identity.modern_element_budget: visible modern content <=10%; 留影玉牌只承担相册记录功能

visual.world_state.recorder: P01 normally uses the handheld image-jade device; at Frame17 P02 temporarily takes P01's device and stays behind the camera with only a dusty-pink sleeve/hand/device-edge fragment allowed in frame; the device returns to P01 from Frame18 onward
visual.world_state.recorder_exception_frame17: photographer=P02; active_device remains P01 image-jade; P01/P03/P04 are the three distant complete figures; P02 must not fully enter frame
visual.world_state.character_presence: P01/P02/P03 present from opening; P04 joins at Frame04; all four remain together until Frame19 goodbye

visual.temporal_continuity.weather_rule: clear/mild/dry throughout; only sun angle and ambient light change
visual.temporal_continuity.continuity_rule: all daypart changes require positive elapsed time; dusk/evening shift is motivated by hours spent together

visual.wardrobe.look_policy: single stable everyday look per character for whole episode unless a visible story reason exists
visual.wardrobe.P01: ivory/light-cyan everyday ruqun-like clothing with light outer layer; practical flat shoes; natural hair
visual.wardrobe.P02: dusty pink-grey and ivory everyday dress; practical flat shoes
visual.wardrobe.P03: grey-blue short jacket and deep-grey trousers
visual.wardrobe.P04: light-brown short top and blue-grey trousers
visual.wardrobe.physics: clothing remains plausible for mild walking/market/bridge activity; no cold-weather or high-altitude special gear needed
